_doc: Reviewed transcription of the Maharashtra State Disaster Management Plan 2023's flood-proneness statement: the plan classifies every district flood-prone EXCEPT eight it names. The plan predates the Ahmednagar/Osmanabad/Aurangabad renamings, so each exception carries both the plan's name and the current one. The classification is the plan's own words; the Atlas adds nothing to it.

source.title: Maharashtra State Disaster Management Plan, 2023
source.publisher: Maharashtra State Disaster Management Authority, Government of Maharashtra

classification.statement: Every district is flood-prone except the eight the plan names.
classification.quote: All districts in the State except Ahmednagar, Beed, Solapur, Latur, Osmanabad, Jalna, Aurangabad, and Buldhana are flood prone.

review.transcribedBy: read from the plan's PDF text by the maintainer's assistant
